children.value: > > Fact From Story The Cowboys' offense looked very much like it did in last season's playoff exit -- uncomfortable and out of sorts.
> > > Fact From Story Dallas was sluggish through the first half of the game, and the night unraveled quickly when Dak Prescott threw three interceptions in the second half.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A sluggish offense and multiple turnovers are indicators of a struggling offense.
> > Fact From Story Brock Purdy threw four touchdowns in the 42-10 rout, including three to George Kittle.
> > > Fact From Story Defensively, the 49ers were relentless.
> > > Fact From Story The 49ers carved up Dallas' defense on the opening drive, and that was a sign of what was to come.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A team whose defense is relentless will be difficult for their opponent to score against.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A team that scores more points than another team in a football game wins.
